name: Astrogem Advisor Hotkeys
description: Global hotkeys that drive the Astrogem Advisor while Lost Ark keeps focus: Ctrl+Shift+1 = Read screen now, Ctrl+Shift+2 = Get advice.

action.default_title: Astrogem Advisor Hotkeys — Ctrl+Shift+1 read, Ctrl+Shift+2 advice

read-screen.description: Read screen now (grab a frame from the shared game screen and parse it)

get-advice.description: Get advice (solve the current window and save the reading)
